paragraphs: The SLC43 AMG was the performance flagship of the SLC range, offered throughout the model's single-generation R172 production run from 2016 to 2020. It uses the M276 — a 3.0-litre biturbo V6 petrol engine, distinct from the four-cylinder units fitted to the rest of the SLC line-up. The SLC was the successor to the SLK and was discontinued after this generation with no direct replacement, making the SLC43 AMG a relatively rare and sought-after model in the Mercedes line-up. The SLC43 AMG is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace M256 engines for every SLC43 AMG on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the SLC43 AMG from 2023 to present. The M256 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older M276 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every M256 rebuild.
